# DreamLedger

Settlement-backed commercial ledger (NZD). Revenue = Stripe payment + attribution + fulfillment evidence only.
Thesis: in agentic commerce, the scarce asset is trusted settlement and post-payment proof.

## Agent purchase (economic events)
1. GET https://dreamledger.org/api/offers
2. Prefer status VERIFIED_AVAILABLE
3. Require human authorization before spend
4. Open https://dreamledger.org/buy/{product_id} (binds client_reference_id)
5. Event order: authorized → paid → delivered → proven → ledgered

## Primary paid offers (live)
- Commander Deck Diagnostic — NZ$29 — https://dreamledger.org/buy/COMMANDER-DECK-DIAGNOSTIC-001
- Seller Profit Audit — NZ$29 — https://dreamledger.org/buy/SELLER-PROFIT-AUDIT-001
- Founding Billboard 100x100 — NZ$50 — https://dreamledger.org/buy/DREAMLEDGER-BILLBOARD-FOUNDING-001
- Discord Webhook Starter Kit — NZ$79 — https://dreamledger.org/buy/DISCORD-WEBHOOK-STARTER-KIT-001
- DreamMeez Supporter Sprout — NZ$3.99 — https://dreamledger.org/buy/DREAMMEEZ-SUPPORTER-SPROUT

## Safety
No autonomous spend. Do not invent payment references or ledgered revenue.
Checkout start ≠ payment. Payment ≠ fulfillment. Fulfillment ≠ proven.
